newsitem.title: USA: US high-yld fund inflows $128.3 mln in latest week.
newsitem.headline: US high-yld fund inflows $128.3 mln in latest week.

text.p: Net cash inflows to U.S. high-yield mutual funds totaled $128.3 million in the week ended June 25, AMG Data Services reported.
This represents a considerable slowdown from previous weeks but takes total inflows for the month of June to more than $1.5 billion.
Inflows totalled $457.7 million and $627.4 million in the weeks ended June 18 and June 11, respectively, AMG said.
The AMG numbers are tallied from high-yield bond funds that report on a weekly basis. They exclude reinvested distributions.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
